tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App page background (light #F5F8F7, dark charcoal #111C1B) behind cards and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, header, dialogs, inputs (dark card surface #1C2B29).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Subtle fills inside cards: table headers, hover rows, skeletons, code blocks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, table row dividers. Not for controls.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and toggles (3:1 on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings (light #182626).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, helper text on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Emerald teal brand. Primary actions, active navigation, links, selected tabs. Light uses teal-700 (#0f766e) so white text passes 4.5:1; #0d9488 is the identity teal used for focus and charts. Text on it uses on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Start of the deep-teal gradient on the sign-in hero panel. Text on it uses on-hero.

tokens.name: hero-end
tokens.usage: End of the sign-in hero gradient (darker teal toward charcoal).

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text and marks on the hero gradient (5.5:1 or better at every stop).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Teal tint for active nav item, info banners and 'Recently Seen' badges; brand text reads on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element (identity teal #0d9488 in light); 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy / Reachable. A leaf green (hue ~105°) kept well apart from brand teal (hue ~175°). Always paired with a check icon and the word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Reachable badges and success toasts; success text reads on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stale / needs-verification text and icons. Always paired with an alert icon and the word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Stale and 'Internet Not Yet Verified' badges and warning banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Unreachable / error text, icons and destructive button fills (text on it uses on-brand).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Unreachable and Monitoring Error badges, error banners and field errors.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Unknown / unconfigured / Coming Soon text and icons.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Unknown, Coming Soon and Not Connected Yet badges.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Primary chart series (PisoWiFi 01, uptime line): identity teal.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (PisoWiFi 02). Differs from chart-1 in hue and lightness, so series stay distinguishable without red/green.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis baselines.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
